keyEvents.text: Goal! West Bromwich Albion 1, Southampton 0. Isaac Price (West Bromwich Albion) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the top right corner.
Delay in match because of an injury George Campbell (West Bromwich Albion).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Nathaniel Phillips replaces George Campbell because of an injury.
Goal! West Bromwich Albion 1, Southampton 1. Samuel Edozie (Southampton) right footed shot from very close range to the bottom left corner.
Delay in match because of an injury James Bree (Southampton).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Callum Styles (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Rabby Nzingoula (West Bromwich Albion) is shown the yellow card.
Substitution, Southampton. Lewis Dobbin replaces Divin Mubama.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Aune Heggebø replaces Felix Myhre.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Harry Whitwell replaces Rabby Nzingoula.
Flynn Downes (Southampton) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, West Bromwich Albion. Tammer Bany replaces Jimmy-Jay Morgan.
Substitution, Southampton. Tom Fellows replaces Kuryu Matsuki.
